import sys,json,copy
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); import gateway

D={
 'sip:alice@local.test':['sip:a@alias.test','tel:+15551234567'],
 'sip:bob@other.test':['tel:+19998887777'],
 'sip:carol@local.test':[],
}
B={
 'directory':D,
 'accounts':{'u':{'primary':'sip:alice@local.test','allow':['sip:carol@local.test']}},
 'gateways':{'g':{'local_domains':['local.test'],'peers':{'p':['other.test'],'q':['local.test']}}},
 'jobs':[]
}
def make(frm='<sip:alice@local.test>', tto='<sip:d@d.test>', extra=None, body='hi', method='MESSAGE', req='sip:d@d.test', cseq='1 MESSAGE', cid='abc', cl=None, omit=(), order=None):
    hs=[f'{method} {req} SIP/2.0', f'From: {frm}', f'To: {tto}', f'Call-ID: {cid}', f'CSeq: {cseq}']
    if extra: hs+=extra
    if cl is None: cl=str(len(body))
    hs.append(f'Content-Length: {cl}')
    names=['request','From','To','Call-ID','CSeq']+(extra or [])+['Content-Length']
    out=[]
    for h,n in zip(hs,names):
        if n in omit: continue
        out.append(h)
    return '\r\n'.join(out)+'\r\n\r\n'+body

def run(raw,ingress={'kind':'local','subject':'u'},trusted=True,gw='g'):
    b=copy.deepcopy(B); b['jobs']=[{'gateway':gw,'ingress':ingress,'trusted_out':trusted,'raw':raw}]
    g=gateway.process(b)['results'][0]
    print(('ACCEPT '+g.get('identity','') if g['status']=='accept' else g['reason']))
    if g['status']=='accept': print(g['wire'].replace('\r','\\r').replace('\n','\\n'))
    return g

if __name__=='__main__':
  cases=[
   ('bare utf', make(frm='SIP:%61lice@LOCAL.TEST.')),
   ('aliases ppi', make(extra=['P-Preferred-Identity: <sip:a@alias.test>'])),
   ('quoted comma', make(frm='"A, B; <x>" <sip:alice@local.test>;tag=x')),
   ('space tag', make(frm=' < sip:alice@local.test > ; tag = foo ')),
   ('table disp', make(frm='Alice\tBob<sip:alice@local.test>')),
   ('empty quoted', make(frm='""<sip:alice@local.test>')),
   ('escaped', make(frm='"a\\\"b" <sip:alice@local.test>')),
  ]
  for n,r in cases:
    print('\n--',n); run(r)
PY
cd /workspace && python3 tmp/explore.py
